notes: Source: observed production targets at each live rebalance (not executed fills). IN/OUT are changes in target membership; HOLD retains continuing names. First observations establish initial membership. Coverage begins at the live start and lists rebalance dates only. Execution prices, daily returns and contributions are unavailable unless independently recorded; missing values are null. No scores are published. From 2026-11-17, rows are the simulator's recorded daily closing marks; daily returns and contributions are computed only between consecutive recorded marks, and a rebalance exit is priced at the removed book's recorded close that session. Positions entered before 2026-11-17 accumulate observed contributions from 2026-11-17 only; earlier days are not reconstructed. On the first recorded day, names in the last rebalance target that the simulated book no longer held (e.g. cash-outs) are listed as removed with no price.
